_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Estimate duty, VAT and landed cost...

description:
Best for: "what will import duty and VAT be on this?" for one item shipped to the UK, US or EU from a known tariff line.
Returns: duty (general rate plus, with origin, US chapter 99 or UK/EU anti-dumping and countervailing duties), VAT, US fees (MPF, HMF) and total in the input currency, plus trade_defence, chapter_99, chapter_99_skipped, complete, missing, sources and notes.
Input tips: pass hs_code (full line: UK or EU 10 digits, US 8 or 10; if given a 4 or 6 digit heading, still call to get the code_not_final child lines), destination ("UK", "US" or "EU"), goods_value and shipping. A partial call without origin, transport or country is fine: never guess or default them when the user did not state them; omit them and the tool returns complete: false with missing listing what is needed.

country.description: EU member state for the VAT rate, such as DE (EU destination). Omit if not stated.

destination.description: Where the goods are imported: "UK", "US" or "EU". EU duty comes from TARIC.

goods_value.description: Value of the goods, such as 80, in the one currency used for every amount (no conversion is done).

hs_code.description: A full tariff line, UK or EU (TARIC) 10 digits or US 8 or 10 digits, dots allowed, such as "6109100010". Copy it from bulk_hs_candidates. A candidate, not binding.

origin.description: 2-letter country the goods were made in (such as CN or VN). Omit when the user did not state a country of origin; never guess or infer origin from the language of the prompt. A partial call without origin returns the base duty with complete: false and missing.

shipping.description: Shipping and insurance to the destination, such as 12, in the same currency. Send 0 if none.

transport.description: How the goods travel into the US (ocean adds the 0.125% harbor fee; air and other add none). Omit when the user did not state transport; never guess. A partial call without transport returns complete: false and missing.

name: landed_cost_estimate

chapter_99.description: US only: extra chapter 99 duties that were added. They are already counted in duty; do not add them again.

reason.description: Why the heading was added or skipped.

chapter_99_skipped.description: US only: chapter 99 headings that matched but were not added, each with the reason.

reason.description: Why the heading was added or skipped.

complete.description: false when a part could not be worked out; then say what missing or notes list.

duty.description: Duty in the input currency. amount is null when the rate is not a plain percentage. Rate and amount already include the chapter_99 lines (US) and the applied trade_defence lines (UK, EU).

basis.description: The value the rate applies to, or "not calculated".

rate.description: The rate applied. With extra duties it reads like 16.5% general + 20% chapter 99 = 36.5% or 4.00% third country + 36.10% anti-dumping = 40.1%.

fees.description: US only: merchandise processing fee (MPF) and harbor fee (HMF).

hs_status.description: Always a candidate code, not a binding classification.

missing.description: What is missing when complete is false.

total.description: Goods, shipping, duty, fees and VAT, in the input currency. Leaves out parts that are null.

trade_defence.description: UK and EU only: anti-dumping, countervailing, additional and safeguard duties for the origin. Applied lines are already counted in duty; do not add them again.

amount.description: Duty in the input currency, already counted in duty; null when not added.

applied.description: true when the amount is in duty and total.

area.description: Origin the measure applies to, such as CN.

basis.description: Which rate was used and why, or why it was not added.

exporter_rates.description: Named exporters with their own rate, and the range of those rates.

legal_act.description: Link to the act that set the duty.

measure.description: Measure as the tariff names it, such as Definitive anti-dumping duty.

rate.description: Rate for exporters without a rate of their own, or null when the tariff lists only named exporters.

vat.description: VAT in the input currency, on goods, shipping and duty. 0 for the US.

title: Estimate duty, VAT and landed cost
